minutes.headline: Planning Board did not act on the Sunset Lane common driveway; applicant withdrew, then two Mass Ave parking waivers passed.
minutes.summary: Most of the meeting was a debate over a common driveway for lots on Rob's Hill Road and Sunset Lane, split over precedent and practicable access. With a member needing to leave and a unanimous vote required, the applicant withdrew. The board then approved site plan waivers for a coffee roaster at 39 Mass Ave and a pet store at 10 Mass Ave, approved a run of earlier minutes, and heard committee and director reports.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment; none offered.
A Howard Street neighbour asked about the coming development hearing on April 29 and whether he would get notice; told abutters within 500 feet get a letter.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board took no decision on the Sunset Lane common driveway; the applicant withdrew and the board accepted the withdrawal.
The board approved a site plan waiver for a coffee roaster at 39 Massachusetts Avenue as presented.
The board approved a waiver for a pet store at 10 Massachusetts Avenue as presented.
The stormwater task force said a consultant contract is needed for the state-mandated plan and that no funding source has been set.
The board scheduled a building reuse discussion for April 29, and set warrant article public hearings, including citizen zoning petitions, for the 22nd.

why_it_matters: The stormwater mandate is unfunded, and the options raised, an enterprise fund or a stormwater utility, would put the cost on residents as a fee or a charge, so it may reach a bill or a Town Meeting vote.
The withdrawn driveway application leaves the question of access for the Rob's Hill Road and Sunset Lane lots unresolved, and the applicant could return.
watch_next: April 29 building reuse discussion, continued to May 13 if needed.
Warrant article public hearings on the 22nd, including citizen zoning petitions.
